numerical_claims.source_evidence: The deviation comes mainly from less sales in Climatic (Nordic) and less growth in North America – with DKK 21-41m.

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit decreased to DKK 131.1 million from DKK 137.9 million, with margin increasing to 48.8% from 46.9%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Gross profit amounted to DKK 131.1m in 2025 (2024: DKK 137.9m) equivalent to a gross margin of 48.8% (2024: 46.9%).
numerical_claims.candidate_value: DKK 131.1 million from DKK 137.9 million, margin 48.8% from 46.9%

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA fell to DKK 28.0 million from DKK 37.3 million, with margin decreasing to 10.4% from 12.7%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Operating profit (EBITDA) amounted to DKK 28.0m in 2025 (2024: DKK 37.3 m) equivalent to an EBITDA margin of 10.4% (2024: 12.7%).
numerical_claims.candidate_value: DKK 28.0 million from DKK 37.3 million, margin 10.4% from 12.7%

numerical_claims.claim: Included DKK 2.5 million of extraordinary costs related to ransomware attack.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Fixed cost was affected negatively with oneoff costs of DKK 2.5m linked to a ransomware attack in May-June.

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings before tax declined to DKK 2.9 million from DKK 12.2 million, profit after tax to DKK 0.9 million from DKK 10.6 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EBT DKK 2.9m (2024: DKK 12.2m), PAT DKK 0.9m (2024: DKK 10.6m)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Earnings before tax (EBT) amounted to DKK 2.9m in 2025 (2024: DKK 12.2m), Profit after tax amounted to DKK 0.9m in 2025 (2024: DKK 10.6m).
numerical_claims.candidate_value: DKK 2.9 million from DKK 12.2 million, DKK 0.9 million from DKK 10.6 million

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The effective tax rate was 70% (2024: 13%). The target is to be above 25%.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating cash flow DKK 28.5 million (2024: DKK 29.4 million).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow from operating activities amounted to DKK 28.5m (2024: DKK 29.4m).

numerical_claims.claim: Investment cash outflows DKK 9.4 million (2024: DKK 17.6 million).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow from investment activities in 2025 amounted to DKK -9.4m (2024: DKK -17.6m).

numerical_claims.claim: Year-end cash DKK 4.0 million, net interest-bearing debt DKK 38.7 million (2024: DKK 36.7 million).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Increase in cash and cash equivalent amounted to DKK 0.6m in 2025 (2024: DKK 0.9m). Net interest-bearing debt at the end of 2025 amounted to DKK 38.7m (End of 2024: DKK 36.7m).
numerical_claims.candidate_value: DKK 4.0 million, DKK 38.7 million, DKK 36.7 million

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial gearing calculated as NIBD/EBITDA amounted to 1.7 at the end of 2025. (End of 2024: 1.2). The target is to be below 2.0.

numerical_claims.claim: Equity DKK 32.5 million, net-cash equity ratio 23.5% (target >25%).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: At the end of 2025, equity amounted to DKK 32.5m (End of 2024: DKK 36.6), equivalent to an equity ratio of 23.5% (net cash). The target is to be above 25%.

numerical_claims.claim: 2026 revenue growth 7-14% to DKK 290-310 million, EBITDA DKK 45-55 million (margin ~8-10%).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: In 2026, revenue is expected to grow organically in range from 7% to 14% to DKK 290-310m, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45-55m, equivalent to an EBITDA-margin of around 8-10%.
